import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, (ax1, ax2)=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(9,4))
fig.suptitle("Rear dump clearance and deployed track")
# side view
ax1.set_aspect('equal'); ax1.set_title("Side: pivot 0.55m clears 0.40m lip")
ax1.plot([0,1.05],[0.11,0.11],'k-',lw=3) # chassis
ax1.plot([0.15,0.15],[0.11,0.22],'k-'); ax1.plot([0.9,0.9],[0.11,0.22],'k-')
ax1.plot([0.15,0.9],[0.22,0.22],'k-')
for x in [0.2,0.85]:
    ax1.add_patch(plt.Circle((x,0.11),0.11,fill=False,lw=2))
ax1.plot([0.9,1.15],[0.55,0.45],'r-',lw=3) # tilted hopper
ax1.plot([1.15,1.15],[0,0.40],'b-',lw=3) # bin lip
ax1.text(1.15,0.42,"bin lip 0.40m",fontsize=8)
ax1.text(0.9,0.57,"pivot 0.55m gap 0.15m",fontsize=8,color='r')
ax1.set_ylim(0,0.8); ax1.set_xlabel("m")
# top view
ax2.set_title("Top: stowed 0.45m to deployed 0.68m track")
ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.1,0.15),0.9,0.30,fill=False,lw=2))
ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.0,0.02),1.05,0.56,fill=False,ls='--'))
for (x,y) in [(0.2,0.02),(0.85,0.02),(0.2,0.46),(0.85,0.46)]:
    ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x,y),0.15,0.12,fill=False,lw=2))
ax2.text(0.4,0.32,"frame stowed box",fontsize=8)
ax2.text(0.3,0.05,"deployed track 0.68m",fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlim(-0.1,1.2); ax2.set_ylim(-0.05,0.65); ax2.set_xlabel("m")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("sketch.png")
